template.name: Web Publisher 2.0
template.description: This template allows you to publish MagicDraw models (including diagrams) in HTML with rich features, so you can view them using a standard browser such as Internet Explorer, Opera, or Firefox.

variable.name: HomeImage
variable.description: Change homepage image by specific value : Empty value for MagicDraw image, Diagram Name for load image from diagram, mdel://elementID for load image from element, file://imagePath for load image from file and http://URL for load image from web site

variable.name: UseContextMenu
variable.description: Enable context menu when click on diagram

variable.name: ShowAppearsInPage
variable.description: Show appears in page in report

variable.name: AutoNavigateHyperlink
variable.description: Auto navigate to active hyperlink of each element. For example, if A has active hyperlink to B and B has active hyperlink to C, C is shown when click on A.

variable.name: DisplayTreeElementId
variable.description: Show id property of element on containment tree

variable.name: ShowAppliedStereotypes
variable.description: Show applied stereotypes of element on containment tree

variable.name: SVGDiagramResizable
variable.description: Resize SVG Image when browser is minimized

variable.name: SkipElementContext
variable.description: Skip iteration all MD elements to create velocity context e.g. $Class, $Package etc.
